name: flytte-store-apps
description: Flytte and Flytte Driver for Google Play and the App Store (Capacitor shells around flytte.co)

scripts.sync: node scripts/prepare-www.js && npm run sync:rider && npm run sync:driver && node scripts/configure-native.js
scripts.open:rider:android: cd rider && npx cap open android
scripts.open:rider:ios: cd rider && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:driver:android: cd driver && npx cap open android
scripts.open:driver:ios: cd driver && npx cap open ios
